headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time risk analysis tools to provide instant feedback on potential vulnerabilities and security threats during the npm/PyPI package installation process, ensuring users have a safer local-first development environment. Improve user experience by automating the detection of binding.gyp command expansions and other potential risks.
actions: Implement a real-time risk assessment engine that scans for known vulnerabilities in npm/PyPI packages before installation, providing immediate alerts to users
Automate the detection and analysis of binding.gyp files during the install process to ensure that any command expansions or other risky operations are flagged
Develop a feature that integrates with existing security databases (e.g., Snyk, npm audit) to provide detailed reports on package dependencies, highlighting any
